name: live-acceptance
notes: Starter evidence artifact only. All scenarios are OPEN until a dated authorized live (or isolated restore) run is recorded.
This file does not claim production deploy success.
This harness checks evidence artifacts; it does not itself run against production unless an evidence file records a dated authorized run.
Do not store secrets, tokens, connection strings, or production hostnames here.
topology: authenticated client -> Helix gateway -> PostgreSQL -> worker -> Kali

normal_exec.label: Normal authenticated task execution through gateway to worker/Kali

worker_termination.label: Worker termination preserves durable task state for reclaim

stale_lease_reclaim.label: Expired lease returns task to PENDING and allows reclaim

duplicate_fencing.label: Duplicate/stale owner identity is fenced from completing

gateway_restart.label: Gateway restart preserves accepted work and resumes safely

db_failure.label: Database failure/outage surfaces safely without false COMPLETE

network_interrupt.label: Network interrupt between gateway/worker/DB does not corrupt task state
